pattern: SELECT .* FROM Students AS S JOIN .* ON S\.current\_address\_id = .*\.address\_id WHERE .* = '.*' AND S\.student\_id NOT IN \(\s*( SELECT DISTINCT student\_id FROM Student_Enrolment )\s*\)
correction: Replace the EXCEPT operator with a subquery using the NOT EXISTS clause to find students from North Carolina who have not enrolled, and use NOT IN for those who live outside North Carolina but have enrolled.

metadata.description: This rule corrects the incorrect usage of the EXCEPT operator in a subquery, which leads to unintended filtering of students enrolled in a degree program.
